portraits.name: 디오구 살가두
portraits.pose: A powerful diagonal rope-hauling action. Three-quarter left stance, torso leaning backward against tension, BOTH hands gripping a thick rope at two different heights in front of chest, one elbow high and one elbow low. The rope runs from upper right to lower left. Bent knees and staggered legs visible down to knees. Face clear, eyes toward rope's upper end.

portraits.name: 누누 세이샤스
portraits.pose: Arms firmly crossed high across muscular chest, fingers resting naturally over opposite upper arms. Torso angled three-quarter right with one shoulder raised, slight sideways lean, face turned back to viewer. A self-assured broad triangular silhouette. Both hands are on upper arms, absolutely not at belt.

portraits.name: 후이 바헤투
portraits.pose: Unfolding a broad flexible parchment nautical chart with BOTH hands spread apart at lower chest, chart angled diagonally toward viewer. Torso slightly bent forward and turned left, head glancing up from the chart. Chart stays below beard and face, visibly different from a relaxed standing pose. No legible letters on chart.

portraits.name: 토메 마레스
portraits.pose: Looking through a simple period brass spyglass held to the RIGHT eye with right hand, left hand supporting its far end. Body three-quarter right, both elbows raised at different angles, leaning slightly forward, head and beard still recognizable. Telescope points diagonally upward to the right, stays within frame.

portraits.name: 가스파르 팔캉
portraits.pose: Actively tying a thick sailor's knot with BOTH hands in front of upper abdomen, gaze focused downward, shoulders hunched slightly forward and torso turned three-quarter left. Both elbows spread outward, rope ends clearly separated, realistic nimble finger grip. No hands resting on belt.

portraits.name: 벤투 발레
portraits.pose: Carrying a heavy coil of thick ship rope over the LEFT shoulder, left hand holding coil near shoulder, right forearm supporting its hanging loops near ribs. Body leans diagonally right under weight, head turned toward viewer. A clearly asymmetrical load-carrying silhouette.

portraits.name: 토머스 리드
portraits.pose: Rolling up the LEFT wet sleeve with the RIGHT hand, left arm extended diagonally forward and down with palm relaxed open. Torso rotated strongly left, weight on back leg, head looking back over right shoulder. Active cloth-gripping fingers, clearly exposed muscular left forearm.

portraits.name: 개러스 홀트
portraits.pose: RIGHT hand raking back windblown hair over the crown, elbow high on one side; LEFT forearm angled outward away from torso with relaxed open palm at rib height. Chest turned three-quarter left and head tipped slightly back into wind. Not both hands on head, no hands on belt.

portraits.name: 에드먼드 쇼
portraits.expression: 낮은 난간에 두 손 짚고 기대기
portraits.pose_label: 낮은 난간에 두 손 짚고 기대기
portraits.pose: Leaning forward with BOTH hands planted far apart on a short low weathered ship railing at thigh height, elbows almost straight, shoulders squared and chin lifted. Knees visible behind rail, torso pitched forward and three-quarter right. Only a minimal short rail prop, no ship background.

portraits.name: 마일스 플린트
portraits.pose: Vigorously wringing a plain wet rag with BOTH hands extended in front of waist, wrists twisting opposite directions, elbows lifted and torso leaning forward three-quarter left. A few small falling water drops from rag. Face visible above hands, shirt stays worn and opaque.

portraits.name: 일라이어스 크로
portraits.pose: Seated sideways on a small plain wooden crate with ONE knee raised high, other leg dropping to knee crop. One elbow rests on raised knee with knuckles lightly under chin, other hand rests on outer raised thigh. Torso inclined forward, face thoughtful. Clearly seated, not a standing belt pose.

portraits.name: 네이선 웨스트
portraits.pose: LEFT arm tucking a rolled parchment chart under armpit, RIGHT arm pointing diagonally outward and up toward the distant route with index finger extended and other fingers naturally curled. Body twisted three-quarter left, chest open, gaze follows pointing direction. Arm bent enough to fit canvas.

portraits.name: 알론소 리바스
portraits.pose: Holding a small open brass compass on LEFT palm at sternum height, RIGHT index finger pointing at its needle. Torso three-quarter right, head inclined downward slightly but face clearly visible, elbows separated. Concentrated navigator stance, no belt grip.

portraits.name: 디에고 카스타뇨
portraits.pose: A dynamic mid-stride pose caught from three-quarter back-left: shoulders and hips counter-rotated, one arm swings forward bent at elbow, the other swings backward, head turns over LEFT shoulder toward viewer. Shirt hem and long hair blow sideways. Head to knees only, no feet. Natural vigorous walking action, not standing.

portraits.name: 마테오 살세도
portraits.pose: Lifting a heavy coarse undyed sailcloth sack onto the RIGHT shoulder, right elbow high and hand bracing top of sack, left hand pressing lower sack near upper chest. Torso tilted left and knees bent slightly under load. Face turned clear toward viewer. Small practical sack, no fancy accessories.

portraits.name: 로드리고 벨라
portraits.pose: BOTH hands loosely clasped BEHIND the lower back, elbows angled backward, chest pushed gently forward. Body is nearly side-on to left, head turned strongly back toward viewer over shoulder, weight shifted onto back leg. Calm poised silhouette with arms behind, no front belt pose.

portraits.name: 후안 세라노
portraits.expression: 목 뒤에 나무 막대 걸치고 쉬기
portraits.pose_label: 목 뒤에 나무 막대 걸치고 쉬기
portraits.pose: A short smooth wooden boat spar balanced horizontally across BACK of shoulders behind neck, BOTH hands gripping its ends from above, elbows wide and raised. Torso turned three-quarter right, chin tipped slightly upward with original sly expression. Wood does not cross face, entire arms fit frame.

portraits.name: 이니고 발데스
portraits.expression: 한 팔로 기대고 물 한 모금 쉬기
portraits.pose_label: 한 팔로 기대고 물 한 모금 쉬기
portraits.pose: Relaxed sideways lean with LEFT forearm resting on a short low rail at one side, RIGHT hand holding a plain wooden cup near chest, one knee bent inward. Body three-quarter left with shoulder dropped, face looking past viewer. Rail only a minimal prop, no background. Clearly asymmetrical resting pose.

portraits.name: 콘라트 아들러
portraits.expression: 긴 목재를 두 팔로 받쳐 들기
portraits.pose_label: 긴 목재를 두 팔로 받쳐 들기
portraits.pose: Carrying a heavy short rough wooden plank diagonally across lower chest and abdomen with BOTH hands supporting underside at two widely spaced points. Knees bent slightly, torso angled three-quarter right and leaning back to balance load. Board stays below face, both muscular arms engaged.

portraits.name: 루카스 브란트
portraits.pose: BOTH hands lifting and settling the two plain linen collar edges beside collarbones, elbows pointing outward at different heights. Head tipped slightly down, torso twisted left with one shoulder advanced. Shirt remains on and opaque, no undressing. Hands stay near neck/collar rather than belt.

portraits.name: 하겐 퀴스터
portraits.pose: Hauling a SMALL wooden bucket upward on a vertical rope: RIGHT hand grips rope high at chest height, LEFT hand grips rope lower near waist, elbows strongly flexed. Bucket hangs near knee level at one side. Torso leans opposite bucket with staggered knees; head turned toward viewer. Entire bucket within canvas.

portraits.name: 마티아스 도른
portraits.expression: 두 팔을 머리 뒤로 뻗어 기지개 켜기
portraits.pose_label: 두 팔을 머리 뒤로 뻗어 기지개 켜기
portraits.pose: A broad stretching pose with BOTH hands clasped behind the HEAD, elbows flared wide and slightly forward, torso arched subtly backward and rotated right. Shirt stretches naturally across muscular chest. Hands and elbows fit inside canvas, head is unobstructed, not touching belt.

portraits.name: 오토 자이델
portraits.pose: Turning a simple weathered wooden ship wheel at LOWER LEFT: left arm reaches downward and outward gripping one spoke, right hand grips a higher spoke near abdomen, torso twists strongly left and leans into turn. Only compact partial wheel as isolated prop, no deck or background. Head looking in sailing direction.

portraits.name: 펠릭스 하르트만
portraits.pose: Brushing sea salt from palms in a brisk hand-clapping gesture at upper chest: palms close but slightly offset and angled toward viewer, elbows asymmetrically bent, torso leaning right with relaxed shoulders. Original subtle smile slightly lively, fingers realistic, no hands at belt. No cartoon effects.

portraits.name: 빌럼 포스
portraits.pose: LEFT hand raised beside and ABOVE head in an open-palm sailor greeting, elbow bent broadly; RIGHT arm held relaxed behind right hip with hand visible at side. Torso leaning three-quarter forward and slightly left, head turned to the approaching viewer. Open readable waving silhouette.

portraits.name: 피터르 드로스트
portraits.pose: An exuberant welcoming pose: BOTH arms spread outward and toward viewer with elbows bent, RIGHT palm higher at shoulder height, LEFT palm lower near ribs, both palms open. Torso leaned back slightly and angled right, original cheerful grin. Arms remain within vertical canvas; no belt grip.

portraits.name: 마르턴 스밋
portraits.pose: Cradling a bulky rolled undyed sailcloth bundle horizontally across BOTH forearms at lower chest, left forearm underneath and right hand holding outer roll. Shoulders curled slightly around load, torso turned three-quarter left, head looking back at viewer. Bundle and hands stay below face.

portraits.name: 야스퍼르 판 레인
portraits.pose: Inspecting a frayed rope end held up between RIGHT thumb and fingers beside chest, LEFT hand pulling the other section taut at lower ribs. Torso close to side-on right, head bent toward raised rope but face visible three-quarter to viewer. Different hand heights and elbows, attentive practical gesture.

portraits.name: 헨드릭 본
portraits.pose: Writing with a quill in a small plain open notebook supported on LEFT forearm at chest height, RIGHT hand actively writing. Torso turned right, head glancing up from notebook toward viewer. Elbows tucked at different heights and shoulder inclined, notebook stays below face.

portraits.name: 클라스 펠트
portraits.pose: Pouring a thin stream of water from a small plain leather water flask in raised RIGHT hand onto extended LEFT forearm held diagonally across lower chest, left palm open. Torso twisted left and leaning slightly away from water; original sly friendly expression. A few restrained water droplets only, no scene background.
